WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    sp.boxx,
    sp.boxz
  FROM scanspatial sp
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
group1 AS (
  SELECT
    arcref,
    fundflux,
    AVG(boxx / boxz) as avg_ratio
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY arcref, fundflux
),
group2 AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    AVG(avg_ratio) as fundflux_avg
  FROM group1
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
final_join AS (
  SELECT
    g1.arcref,
    g1.fundflux,
    g1.avg_ratio,
    g1.avg_ratio - g2.fundflux_avg as diff
  FROM group1 g1
  INNER JOIN group2 g2 ON g1.fundflux = g2.fundflux
  WHERE g1.avg_ratio > g2.fundflux_avg
)
SELECT
  arcref,
  fundflux,
  avg_ratio,
  diff
FROM final_join
ORDER BY 
  diff IS NULL,
  diff DESC
LIMIT 10
